name: Directed Chaos
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Marotte

EFFECT

Range: Medium (130 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area: 10-ft.-radius burst

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature within the area of effect takes 1d10 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level2 is driven (as the condition) until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a marotte, the target’s base speed increases by 10 feet while it is driven.
